# Pritesh Rathod - Developer Documentation

> Machine-readable guide to the APIs, schemas, and developer resources of Pritesh Rathod.

## APIs & Specs
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/openapi.json): Complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 JSON schema
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/api/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI specification in YAML format
- [Agent Authentication](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/auth.md): Auth walkthrough per WorkOS auth.md spec
- [API Catalog](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset document
- [MCP Server Card](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol tools

## Endpoints
- [Health Check](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/health): GET /health
- [Projects API](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/projects): GET /api/projects
- [Skills API](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/skills): GET /api/skills
- [Contact API](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/contact): POST /api/contact
